properties.Name: Kozuch Football Performance Complex
properties.description: The Football Performance Complex is a three level building adjoined to the north end of Mollenkopf Athletic Center. It includes a locker room, weight room, coaching offices, meeting rooms, a player development room, equipment areas, and a space for sports medicine. The building's purpose is to centralize all football activities. The Football Performance Complex was designed by the Populous architectural firm who alos designed the Aviva Stadium in Dublin, the Jacksonville Jaguars Amphitheater and Flex Field, Yankee Stadium, and the London and Sochi Olympic Stadiums.
properties.dedicationinfo: The Purdue Board of Trustees approved the naming the Football Performance Complex the Kozuch Football Performance Complex in recognition of an anonymous, very generous gift from a donor.
